title: Lena and the Bakery
author: Ada Brightwater
blurb: Yara Whitlock, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
